payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort heroes; for each dragon, binary search to find the best hero (just below or above x), then compute minimal coins via direct formulas.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the array and uses bisect_left to quickly locate candidate heroes. It then greedily picks the better of sending the hero just below x or the one at/above x, computing cost in O(1). This is a classic greedy choice on sorted data.
